title: Hearty Kenyan Stew
description: A flavorful and comforting stew originating from Kenya, featuring earthy spices and tender beef.

ingredients.name: earthly spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most African or international markets

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the earthly spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste, if using, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the stew broth and bring to a boil.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the stew to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the beef is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
